name: thinking-steering-benchmarks
description: A collection of benchmarks designed to evaluate how model outputs can be steered by different 'thinking' or chain-of-thought style prompts. It measures the degree to which models change reasoning behavior and final answers when provided with different internal monologue or steering instructions. Tasks probe robustness of reasoning and susceptibility to instruction-based manipulation.
reputation: A small, recent research benchmark with limited but growing attention from researchers studying chain-of-thought and prompt steering.
